aafebbded10a.title: Backend Developer Intern (Go)

summary.text: Sample Cloud Co wants a backend developer intern (go) to ship production code with a small team. Students pursuing a CS degree with one systems language are a fit.
responsibilities: Design, build and test production code
Present a project at the end of the term
qualifications: Pursuing a BS/MS in CS or related
One of Python, Go, TypeScript or C++

aafebbded10a.description_html:
Sample Cloud Co is looking for a Backend Developer Intern (Go) to join a small team shipping real features.

What you will do

  • Design, build and test production code
  • Pair with senior engineers
  • Present your project at the end of the summer

What we look for

  • Currently pursuing a BS/MS in CS or a related field
  • Experience with one of Python, Go, TypeScript or C++
  • Curiosity and clear written communication

Pay range: $42.00 to $55.00 USD hourly. We do not sponsor work visas for this role.

Equal opportunity employer. Accommodation requests are welcome.
